title: 'Read the tally marks by the smoke rack (DC 9, wits)' is offered on first arrival but silently disappears from the menu two turns later (after asking the hunter about herbs), without ever being taken and with no in-fiction explanation - replaced by an unrelated 'search the brush' action.
